author: Otaldo
quote: To this day I don't understand why this game is so criticized. The graphics, soundtrack, and storyline are INCREDIBLE. Seriously, what a beautiful storyline! It has 6 endings, and that's wonderful, I love everything about this game. The only bad things are the frame rate drops and the combat system. Unfortunately, it's not available for PC.
